text: 深圳市国资委公布《深圳市属国资国企2025社会责任暨ESG报告》，《报告》显示，截至2025年底，深圳市属国企战略性新兴产业总资产达4889亿元，较2025年初增长9.3%。深圳已形成超500只的国资基金群，基金总规模突破7000亿元，其中超90%资金投向深圳“20+8”战略性新兴产业和未来产业。
text_en: The State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of Shenzhen Municipality released the '2025 Social Responsibility and ESG Report of Shenzhen Municipal State-owned Assets and Enterprises.' The report shows that as of the end of 2025, the total assets of strategic emerging industries of Shenzhen municipal state-owned enterprises reached 488.9 billion yuan, an increase of 9.3% from the beginning of 2025. Shenzhen has formed a group of more than 500 state-owned capital funds, with total fund scale exceeding 700 billion yuan, of which more than 90% of funds are invested in Shenzhen's '20+8' strategic emerging industries and future industries.
